name: Galculator
description:
galculator is a GTK-based scientific calculator that balances simplicity with advanced computational features. It provides an intuitive interface for basic calculations, mathematical formulas, and scientific computations.

Features:
- Supports Basic, Scientific, and Paper mathematical modes
- Algebraic notation and Reverse Polish Notation (RPN) computation modes
- Number base conversions between decimal, hexadecimal, octal, and binary
- Trigonometric, hyperbolic, logarithmic, and statistical functions
- User-defined constants and customizable interface display preferences
